exercises.question: Which sentence has the correct hypothetical pattern? [¿Cuál tiene la estructura hipotética correcta?]
options: Si ocurriera algo inesperado, buscaríamos otra solución. [If something unexpected happened, we would look for another solution.]
Si ocurriría algo inesperado, buscaríamos otra solución. [If something unexpected happened, we would look for another solution.]
Si ocurrió algo inesperado, buscaríamos otra solución. [If something unexpected happened, we would look for another solution.]

exercises.sentence: Si __ de mí, cambiaría el plan. (depender) [If it depended on me, I would change the plan.]

exercises.english: If we had more information, we could decide better.

sentences: Si ocurriera algo inesperado. [If something unexpected happened.]
Buscaríamos otra solución. [We would look for another solution.]
Si ocurriera algo inesperado, buscaríamos otra solución. [If something unexpected happened, we would look for another solution.]

exercises.question: Which form follows «si» in this pattern? [¿Qué forma sigue a «si»?]
options: ocurriera [happened]
ocurriría [would happen]
ocurre [happens]

exercises.sentence: Si la hipótesis __ correcta, el resultado sería diferente. (ser) [If the hypothesis were correct, the outcome would be different.]

options: If the hypothesis were correct, the outcome would be different.
